result.instructions: Tools for Sensorist, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our sensors reported a temperature above 25 degrees in the last 24 hours?"; "Show the alarm history for the cellar gateway this month."; "What is the latest humidity reading on each gateway?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sensorist data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sensorist_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sensorist_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sensorist_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sensorist_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sensorist_get_user
tools.title: Get the account
tools.description: Get the user and account details of the signed-in Sensorist login. With list=true, return every user in the account hierarchy. Sensorist API: GET /v1/users.

list.description: true = return an array of all users in your hierarchy instead of only your own user.

tools.name: sensorist_list_gateways
tools.title: List gateways
tools.description: List the gateways (device inventory) of the account. Each gateway lists its sensors, and each sensor its data sources (the ids the measurement tool needs). By default only master gateways are returned. Sensorist API: GET /v1/gateways.

serials.description: Only gateways with these serial numbers.

from.description: Only gateways added to the account after this date.

tools.name: sensorist_get_measurements
tools.title: Get measurements
tools.description: Get sensor measurements for data sources of ONE gateway. type: latest (most recent values), min_max (minimum and maximum with dates), climate (ETCCDI climate days), range (grouped average, minimum and maximum) or raw (unfiltered, up to 5,000 per page; pass the reply's next value as offset to read on). The default period is the past week. Sensorist API: GET /v1/measurements.

data_sources.description: Data source ids, all from the same gateway (from sensorist_list_gateways).

indices.description: climate only: which indices to return (default all).

ticks.description: range only: approximate number of values to return.

interval.description: range only: grouping interval in minutes.

seq_from.description: raw only: first sequence number to return.

seq_to.description: raw only: last sequence number to return.

offset.description: raw only: the next value from the previous reply.

tools.name: sensorist_list_alarms
tools.title: List alarms
tools.description: List the data source alarms set by the account and their current state, with the most recent log entries. Sensorist API: GET /v1/alarms.

include_notes.description: true = include the notes on each alarm.

tools.name: sensorist_list_alarm_history
tools.title: List alarm history
tools.description: Get the alarm log history: when each alarm went into and out of alarm. By default the entries are in time order. format=pairs returns each in/out pair together; format=combined adds system notifications. Sensorist API: GET /v1/alarms/history.

format.description: pairs = in/out pairs; combined = with system notifications.

include_notes.description: true = include the notes on each entry.
